| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Edges | Edges, Smoothed, Band-limited Laplacian, Binary Laplacian | The edge map, or one of the stages. The Laplacian is shown as 128 plus 4 times its value, our choice. |
| **Smoothing factor b** `b` | 0.8 | 0.1 to 0.98 | The factor b of the ISEF, from 0 to 1. Our choice of 0.8. |
| **Low threshold** `low` | 2 | 0 to 50 | The low hysteresis threshold on the gradient of the smoothed image, in levels per pixel. Our choice of 2. |
| **High threshold** `high` | 5 | 0 to 100 | The high hysteresis threshold, in levels per pixel. An edge must reach it somewhere. Our choice of 5. |
